_comment: Documentation-sync policy for thehub-pr (ADR 0010, extending ADR 0004). Read by tools/check_docs_sync.py. couplings: when a covered path changes, the doc must change in the same diff, or the commit/PR says 'Docs-Impact: none - <reason>'. Seeded conservatively: each coupling was replayed over recent history and either never fired or fired with the doc already updated. Add couplings for docs that enumerate things; do not add ones that fire on routine work.

couplings.why: 'Active producer map' mirrors the producer registry and 'The producer contract' restates the manifest schema.
Roles names every producer, the registration protocol lists the registry status values, and the topology follows the dependency graph.
'Canonical streams & id namespaces' has one row per federation_* stream schema.
Declares how the producers are grouped and connected, which the registry and dependency graph encode.
Reports the branch-protection and merge-blocking state recorded there.
